name: prompt-router
description: Before each prompt, picks where it belongs (this chat, a subagent or a new session), which model and which effort, and offers it

project.title: Project
project.description: What your chats are about, in a few words (e.g. a React and Django web app). Empty: a software project.

rules.title: Extra rules
rules.description: Your own routing rules, appended to the classifier prompt and taking precedence (e.g. Database migrations: opus, high.)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for the reason and for the questions Claude asks (e.g. English, Czech). auto: the language of each prompt.

classifier.title: Classifier model
classifier.description: The model that makes the routing call on each prompt. haiku is the cheapest and fastest, sonnet the default, opus the most accurate but slowest and most expensive (it runs on every prompt).

effortDetection.title: Effort detection
effortDetection.description: The effort for a prompt that stays in this chat. ask: Claude asks you before it changes. auto: the router sets it by itself. off: the router never touches the effort. Replaces effortMode.

firstChatDetection.title: First-chat model detection
firstChatDetection.description: On the first prompt of a new chat, checks whether the selected model fits the task. ask: Claude asks you before switching. auto: switches it by itself. off: never touches the model. Replaces modelMode.

midChatModelDetection.title: Mid-chat model detection
midChatModelDetection.description: A later prompt that stays here but fits another model. ask: Claude offers a subagent on that model or staying here. auto: Claude picks one itself with no question and says what it chose. off: only the effort is judged (modelMode off also turns this off).

subagentSuggestions.title: Subagent suggestions
subagentSuggestions.description: ask: Claude offers a subagent for a self-contained task, or one on another model mid-chat. auto: the subagent starts right away and Claude says so in one sentence. off: such a prompt stays in this chat.

sessionSuggestions.title: Session suggestions
sessionSuggestions.description: ask: Claude offers a new session for an unrelated task. off: such a prompt stays in this chat.

newSessionAt.title: New session when the chat is long
newSessionAt.description: Any prompt, once this chat holds this share of its model's context window, is offered as a new session (every reply here re-reads the whole context). off: only the classifier decides. Needs sessionSuggestions ask.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: on: a toast after the router changes the model or effort by itself, and a label in the footer. off: neither; the changes still happen.

stats.title: Savings stats
stats.description: on: notes each routing decision and each turn's token use in ~/.claude/mods-logs/prompt-router-stats.jsonl (local only), shows the estimated saving in the footer and in /router stats. off: nothing is noted.

openPane.title: Open the pane by itself
openPane.description: on: the Prompt Router pane opens when a session starts (from 144 terminal columns, 110 once you have opened it with /router panel), or else on your first prompt. off: only /router panel opens it.

compareWith.title: Compare savings with
compareWith.description: What the savings are measured against: a model at an effort for every chat (opus-medium, Anthropic's pick for everyday work), first: the model the chat started on, or history: the mix of models and efforts you ran before the router, weighted by tokens (counted once in the background from your transcripts; Opus medium until then). Repriced from the logged tokens, so old data follows the choice.
